title: Custom Join/Leave
description: Custom Join/Leave Plugins created by DuckyRuby55!
body:
# 🧩Custom Message
What can this plugin do?
When a player joins or leaves, a custom message is displayed in the chat that can be modified in the config.yml file.

# Example
[+] DuckyRuby55 (Join Message)

[-] DuckyRuby55 (Leave Message)

[++] DuckyRuby55 (New Player Message)

# 🛠️Version
Version: 1.21.1 - 1.21.10 Java: 21 Type: Spigot, Paper and Bukkit.
